title: Nourishing Egyptian Soya Bean Flatbread
description: A buttery, creamy flatbread infused with aromatic Egyptian spices and protein-rich soya bean flour, perfect for a brunch-mood meal that is dairy-free and welcoming.
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine soya bean flour, all-purpose flour, yeast, salt, cumin, coriander, dill, and black pepper.
Stir the dry ingredients until evenly mixed.
Add honey and warm water to the dry mixture and stir until a sticky dough forms.
Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for about 5 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in an oiled bowl, cover, and let it rise in a warm spot for 30 minutes until doubled in size.
Preheat the oven to 220°C and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Divide the dough into four equal portions and roll each into a flat circle about 10 cm in diameter.
Brush the tops of the flatbreads with olive oil and sprinkle a pinch of tahini on each if using.
Bake the flatbreads for 15 minutes until golden brown and slightly puffed.
Remove from the oven, let cool slightly, and serve warm with a drizzle of olive oil or your favorite dairy-free sauce.
